p0_patterns.suppression_condition: Single short glance, low head quality (< 0.25), or turn toward empty aisle

p0_patterns.activation_condition: Torso lean angle >= 15.0 deg toward a configured neighbor persisting >= 1.0s
p0_patterns.suppression_condition: Normal writing posture, short stretch (< 0.8s), or lean toward aisle
p0_patterns.corroborating_cue: Concurrent head turn in same direction

p0_patterns.activation_condition: Seat occupied -> empty duration >= 15.0s without foreground occlusion
